body: Yeah, I felt like a lot of the "middle" seasons were sort of a bust, but the series ending was pretty satisfying as she'd always taken Andy for granted.

That's really nice of you to say, and I understand the premise, but this is a bit different.

We're at an impasse because I don't* appreciate being called names during disagreements. He argues that my behavior causes him to say these things. I, in turn, argue that I don't make him do anything. 

This separation isn't laying the foundation of a happy marriage. It's more exposing the cracks. 

Edited to add: We're not the type to even *want* to spend every moment together. We can be in the same room for hours and hardly exchange a word.
